name: Doppel - Sync Alerts
details: Scheduled trigger for the 'Doppel - Sync Alerts' playbook. Keeps Doppel incidents/issues in sync with the Doppel platform on deployments without native mirroring, such as Cortex XSIAM: applies Doppel-side changes to the matching incidents/issues and archives Doppel alerts whose incidents/issues were closed by analysts. On Cortex XSOAR, prefer the integration's native mirroring and leave this job disabled.
